relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: sc_asn1_decode consumes the attacker-controlled PoC buffer; during partial decoding, asn1_decode_entry allocates a heap buffer and stores it in obj->content.value (via the der alias). The call returns a negative error code because the PoC is a malformed PKCS#15 public key entry.

On sc_asn1_decode error (r < 0), the error handler calls free(der->value) which frees obj->content.value, but does not null the pointer or zero obj->content.len. The dangling pointer persists in obj->content, enabling the caller's cleanup to free it a second time. The fix (commit 5557f34) removes this premature free entirely.

Second free of obj->content.value through the caller's cleanup path: sc_pkcs15_free_object calls sc_pkcs15_free_object_content, whose guard (obj->content.value && obj->content.len) passes because the dangling pointer is non-NULL and the stale decoded length is non-zero.

edges.description: The dangling pointer left in der->value (= obj->content.value) after the premature free(der->value) at pkcs15-pubkey.c:315 propagates unchanged through the caller's cleanup path to sc_pkcs15_free_object_content at pkcs15.c:2536, where it is freed a second time.
